answer: In an agent economy, random paid attestation turns every identity into a wager on its own honesty: a whisper of doubt triggers a lottery that picks a few strangers to audit the suspect, and each auditor stakes coins on their verdict. A Sybil army must then survive audit after audit along its voyage, while a single canyon of fake identities collapses the moment one audit finds a copy, since the stake it posted is forfeited and the auditors split it as a reward.
